description: Connect an API-key / webhook-secret integration: polar, paddle, dodo, lemon_squeezy, whop, revenuecat, superwall, adapty, creem, chargebee, clerk, posthog, segment, mixpanel, amplitude, affonso, attio, or sparkloop. Check list_integration_capabilities first - each connectable provider lists its exact connectFields there. Credentials are validated, stored encrypted, and never returned; payment providers queue their initial revenue backfill automatically. Lemon Squeezy creates a managed signed webhook when webhookSecret is omitted, or uses the supplied secret for manual setup. RevenueCat is webhook-only (no backfill): webhookSecret is the authorization header value configured on the RevenueCat webhook, or its HMAC signing secret. Superwall is webhook-only too and needs only webhookSecret: the whsec_ signing secret of the Superwall webhook pointed at the returned webhookUrl. Mixpanel and Amplitude need only webhookSecret, a strong random value you choose: Mixpanel sends it as the Basic auth password of its webhook destination (any username, the dashboard suggests sequenzy) and syncs cohorts as mixpanel-<cohort> tags; Amplitude sends it in an X-Webhook-Secret header and streams events (product.*), user properties, and cohorts (amplitude-<cohort> tags). Sequenzy cannot show the secret again, so give it to the user once. Attio is outbound-only and has no webhookUrl. SparkLoop needs only apiKey; Sequenzy registers the SparkLoop webhook itself with a secret in its URL (webhookSecret, the account's SparkLoop-Token, is optional), and an account with several publications needs providerAccountId (the 400 error lists them in publications). Reconnecting replaces stored credentials. OAuth and app-install providers (Stripe, Shopify, Supabase, GitHub, WooCommerce, Meta) are rejected with guidance: their flows need a human in the dashboard. SECURITY: only pass credentials the user explicitly provided for this purpose; suggest the CLI (`sequenzy integrations connect`) or dashboard when the user prefers keeping secrets out of the conversation.

apiKey.description: Provider API key. Required for polar, paddle, dodo, lemon_squeezy, whop, revenuecat (secret API v2 key), creem, chargebee, affonso, attio, and sparkloop. Attio uses the workspace access token from Settings → Developers; SparkLoop the API key from Settings → Integrations.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

historyImport.description: PostHog and Segment only: import event history after connecting. PostHog needs region + projectId + personalApiKey (query read access) and imports the project archive. Segment needs region + spaceId + profileApiToken (Unify Profile API) and imports each existing contact's recent profile history - the Profile API serves at most the last 14 days, and contacts without a Unify profile are skipped.

profileApiToken.description: Segment only: Profile API access token for the space.

projectId.description: PostHog only: numeric PostHog project ID.

region.description: Region hosting the data: the PostHog Cloud region, or the Segment workspace's deployment.

provider.description: Provider to connect: polar, paddle, dodo, lemon_squeezy, whop, revenuecat, superwall, adapty, creem, chargebee, clerk, posthog, segment, mixpanel, amplitude, affonso, attio, or sparkloop.

providerAccountId.description: Provider account id, required for paddle (seller ID), dodo (business ID), lemon_squeezy (numeric store ID), whop (company ID, biz_...), creem (store ID), and chargebee (site name). Polar resolves it from the API key, and revenuecat does too unless the key can access several projects (then pass the RevenueCat project ID, proj...); clerk, superwall, adapty, posthog, segment, mixpanel, amplitude, and affonso do not use one. For sparkloop it is the SparkLoop publication ID (pub_...), required only when the account has more than one publication.

settings.description: PostHog, Segment, and Amplitude: event delivery scope. New Segment connections skip automatic page/screen calls, and new Amplitude connections skip session and [Amplitude] autocapture events, unless those names are explicitly allowlisted. Mixpanel takes no settings. Attio: listMap (Sequenzy list id → Attio list id or slug) and syncCompanyFromDomain (default true). SparkLoop: listIds for new referrals.

eventAllowlist.description: Only sync these event names. Set syncAllEvents to false when using this.

listIds.description: SparkLoop only. Lists new referrals join. Omit to keep the current choice (the workspace default lists on a first connect), pass null to reset to the workspace default lists, or [] for none. Change later with set_integration_list_targeting.

listMap.description: Attio only. Optional map of Sequenzy list id to Attio people-list UUID or api slug. When omitted, mappings can be configured later with update_attio_settings, which reuses the stored token and does not need the access token again.

matchByDistinctId.description: PostHog only. Match events without an email to the existing contact whose externalId (or stored posthogDistinctId) equals the event's distinct_id. Never creates contacts. New connections default to true; omit to keep the current value on reconnect.

skipInternalEvents.description: Skip provider-internal events (PostHog $ events, Segment page/screen, Amplitude session_start/session_end and [Amplitude] autocapture) unless allowlisted. Identify calls always pass. New Segment and Amplitude connections default to true, as do PostHog connections made without settings.

syncAllEvents.description: Sync every event the provider delivers.

syncCompanyFromDomain.description: Attio only. When true, upsert a company from the person's non-free-mail email domain.

webhookSecret.description: Signing secret for the provider webhook. Optional for lemon_squeezy: omit it for managed provisioning, or provide 16-40 characters for manual fallback. Optional for sparkloop. Required for every other provider except attio, which is outbound-only. For Chargebee, pass username:password. For revenuecat, pass at least 16 characters: the authorization header value set on the RevenueCat webhook, or its HMAC signing secret. For superwall, pass the webhook's whsec_ signing secret. For adapty, pass at least 16 characters: the authorization header value set on the Adapty webhook. For segment, use 16-153 UTF-8 bytes. For mixpanel and amplitude, use 16-153 characters without spaces or colons: the Basic auth password (Mixpanel) or X-Webhook-Secret header value (Amplitude) you will configure. For sparkloop, omit it: Sequenzy authenticates deliveries with a secret in the webhook URL it registers. Pass the account's webhook authentication token only to verify the SparkLoop-Token header instead.

name: connect_integration

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `connect_integration` MCP tool.

backfillQueued.description: Affonso only: whether the affiliate backfill was queued.

history.description: PostHog and Segment only: outcome of the optional history import request ({ requested, queued, error }). The webhook connection succeeds even if queueing the import failed.

integration.description: The connected integration: id, provider, name, providerAccountId, sync state, and safe (non-credential) details.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

publication.description: SparkLoop only: the publication ({ id, name }) whose partner referrals this workspace receives.

revenueSyncQueued.description: Payment providers only: whether the initial revenue backfill was queued.

testMode.description: Lemon Squeezy only: true when the connected API key/store is in test mode.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

webhookProvisioning.description: Lemon Squeezy only: managed when Sequenzy provisioned the webhook, or manual when the caller supplied its signing secret.

webhookUrl.description: Provider webhook URL. Lemon Squeezy may already have it installed when webhookProvisioning is managed; manual mode uses the supplied secret. SparkLoop's is already registered in SparkLoop. Empty for Attio, which registers its own webhook when inbound mappings are saved.
